answer: Because the timing is written down against the crystal challenge, the vine audit can replay the tundra history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 215 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
